 Adam Wyden - ADW Capital (Manager Meetings, EP.37) 
 
 Adam Wyden - ADW Capital (Manager Meetings, EP.37) Sep 22, 2022

 On today’s Manager Meeting, Savneet Signh interviews Adam
Wyden.

Savneet is the President and CEO of PAR Technology Corp, a $1.5
billion market cap public technology company, the Chairman of
CoVenture, and a past guest on Capital Allocators earlier this
year, sharing his unique perspectives as a successful operator and
investor.

Adam is the founder and Managing Partner of ADW Capital, a $350
million concentrated, small cap, long-biased fund he launched with
$0.5 million in 2011. ADW’s largest position is PAR Technology.

Their conversation covers the launch of ADW, the evolution of the
fund’s strategy from activism to quality, research process, lessons
learned, and opportunities going forward.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
